name: Jesus
summary: The Gospels describe Jesus as a teacher and healer. They tell of his followers, death by crucifixion, and reports of resurrection.
context: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John give accounts with shared scenes and distinct details. Acts describes his followers after his death. This profile attributes claims to these texts. It does not treat every account as an independently verified event.
limits: Unpublished draft. No claim of agreement across every Gospel or independent historical confirmation. No Exile/Return era is added. Stories retain their narrative-only scope.
